item.title: Remarkable advances in prenatal surgery for babies in the womb
item.description: A new peer-reviewed article published by the Charlotte Lozier Institute (CLI) examines three decades of progress in prenatal surgery for babies diagnosed with spina bifida, showing how these advances have improved treatment and dramatically improved quality of life outcomes.

item.title: Nearly 100,000 people have been euthanised in Canada
item.description: The Office of the Chief Coroner of Ontario recently released the euthanasia report for the fourth quarter of 2025. It reveals that in Ontario there were 5,303 reported deaths from euthanasia in 2025, up from 4,944 in 2024, representing a 7.2% increase

item.title: Holly Cairns misleads Dáil with abortion claims
item.description: Social Democrats leader Holly Cairns misled the Dáil on Wednesday when she suggested to the Taoiseach that 240 Irish women travel to England each year for abortions when their babies were detected to have a life-limiting condition, when in fact a small minority of these women travelled for that reason over a five year period.

item.title: Bishops raise their voices in support of unborn human life
item.description: Last week, during their Spring General Meeting in Saint Patrick’s College, Maynooth, the Irish Catholic Bishops issued a statement in defence of life and offered their prayerful support for expectant mothers and their unborn children.
